in_sanskrit.name: Ripu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ruler, King, Master
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ripu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who rules, king, master, one who has control over others, the one who is the ruler of the mind and the senses

in_hindi.name: Ripu
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Ruler, King, Master
in_hindi.long_meaning: Ripu एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who rules, king, master, one who has control over others, the one who is the ruler of the mind and the senses

in_tamil.name: Ripu
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Ruler, King, Master
in_tamil.long_meaning: Ripu ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who rules, king, master, one who has control over others, the one who is the ruler of the mind and the senses

in_telugu.name: Ripu
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Ruler, King, Master
in_telugu.long_meaning: Ripu ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who rules, king, master, one who has control over others, the one who is the ruler of the mind and the senses

in_marathi.name: Ripu
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler, King, Master
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ripu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who rules, king, master, one who has control over others, the one who is the ruler of the mind and the senses

in_bengali.name: Ripu
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Ruler, King, Master
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ripu একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who rules, king, master, one who has control over others, the one who is the ruler of the mind and the senses
